notes: v1.0. Headline = 5-yr score (V75/F15/M10, local currency) + entry-timing score (T60/M40) + rough expected 5-yr INR return net of cost. Valuation norms (fwd PE, CAPE, dividend yield) are computed from global-indices-valuation-history.csv. access/cost_pct are estimates (annual all-in cost incl. FoF layer / remittance; verify fund availability and the industry overseas-investment limit before acting). weight_mult scales one indicator's weight; anchors override (cheap, rich); high_inflation judges currency in real terms; real_growth overrides REAL_GROWTH.
